description: DOI check: exists, retracted, or fabricated (batch of 20) — Checks up to 20 DOIs in one call against Crossref (including its Retraction Watch notices), OpenAlex and the doi.org Handle registry. Per DOI: FOUND with title and year, RETRACTED, EXPRESSION_OF_CONCERN, CORRECTED, REGISTERED_NOT_INDEXED, NOT_REGISTERED (no such DOI anywhere: likely fabricated), INVALID_DOI or UNVERIFIED.
